title: 第一卷 第11章 青元养身诀，古卷藏天机
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
辞别清议阁，夜色浸染青玄宗群山。

    晚风微凉，林间虫鸣细碎。

    苏玄尘独自走在回往后山的石阶路上。

    手中静静握着一枚淡青色玉简，触手温润，灵气内敛。

    正是柳长老赠予的《青元养身诀》。

    一路行来，沿途偶遇的弟子，无不停步侧身，目光复杂地望向他。

    先前的轻视与嘲弄，早已尽数收敛。

    取而代之的，是敬畏、忌惮，还有一丝难以掩饰的惋惜。

    所有人都清楚了他的身份——千年难遇的极品天灵根。

    可同样所有人都认定，这位百岁老者，空有绝世资质，难活长久。

    寿元枯竭，朽躯难支，是他跨越不了的死局。

    对此，苏玄尘心如止水，全然不在意旁人目光。

    旁人看的是他的年岁、他的短板。

    唯有他自己清楚，他最大的底牌，从未暴露分毫。

    回到后山破败小院，落锁封窗，隔绝一切外界动静。

    石屋之内，只剩一盏油灯摇曳，光影斑驳。

    苏玄尘盘膝坐定，神识沉入手中玉简。

    海量文字信息，瞬间涌入脑海。

    《青元养身诀》，残缺锻体法门。

    不修杀伐，不练灵力，专一滋养肉身、润化经脉、填补气血亏空。

    专为肉身衰败、气血枯竭的修士量身打造。

    “柳长老倒是有心。”

    苏玄尘低声呢喃。

    这门功法，对寻常少年修士毫无用处，甚至堪称鸡肋。

    但对如今的他而言，恰到好处，价值千金。

    百年朽躯，经脉淤堵、气血凋零、生机微弱。

    常规修炼功法，只会一味吸纳灵气，强行冲刷躯体，治标不治本。

    长久下去，只会让衰败的肉身负荷更重，加速寿元耗尽。

    而这《青元养身诀》，以温润灵气养骨、养脉、养气血。

    循序渐进，润物无声，一点点修补百年暗伤。
content_en:
Farewell to Qingyi Pavilion, the night is soaked in the Qingxuanzong mountains.

    The evening breeze is slightly cool, and the insects in the forest are chirping softly.

    Su Xuanchen walked alone on the stone steps back to the back mountain.

    Quietly holding a light blue jade slip in his hand, the tentacles are warm and the aura is restrained.

    It was the "Qing Yuan Health Secret" given by Elder Liu.

    Along the way, the disciples he met by chance stopped and turned sideways, looking at him with complicated eyes.

    The previous contempt and ridicule have all been restrained.

    Instead, there was awe, fear, and a trace of regret that could not be concealed.

    Everyone knew his identity—a rare-for-a-thousand-year-old top-grade Tianlinggen.

    But everyone also believed that this hundred-year-old man had no peerless qualifications and would not live long.

    His longevity is exhausted and his body is in decay, which is a dead end that he cannot overcome.

    Regarding this, Su Xuanchen felt calm and didn't care about the eyes of others at all.

    What others see is his age and his shortcomings.

    Only he knows that his biggest trump card has never been exposed.

    Returning to the dilapidated courtyard at the back of the mountain, he locked the windows and blocked out all outside noise.

    In the stone house, there was only one oil lamp swaying, and the light and shadow were mottled.

    Su Xuanchen sat cross-legged and his consciousness sank into the jade slip in his hand.

    A large amount of text information floods into my mind instantly.

    "Qingyuan Body-nurturing Secret" is a complete body-building method.

    Not practicing killing or practicing spiritual power, but focusing on nourishing the physical body, moistening the meridians, and filling the deficiency of Qi and blood.

    It is specially designed for monks whose physical body has declined and whose energy and blood have been exhausted.

    "Elder Liu is really thoughtful."

    Su Xuanchen murmured softly.

    This technique is of no use to ordinary young monks, and is even considered useless.

    But for him now, it's just right and worth a fortune.

    The body has been decayed for hundreds of years, the meridians are blocked, the Qi and blood are withered, and the vitality is weak.

    Conventional cultivation methods will only absorb the spiritual energy and forcefully wash away the body, treating the symptoms but not the root cause.

    If it goes on for a long time, it will only put a heavier load on the decaying body and accelerate the depletion of life span.

    And this "Qing Yuan Health Nurturing Secret" uses warm and moist spiritual energy to nourish bones, pulses, qi and blood.

    Step by step, moisturize things silently, and repair centuries-old hidden wounds bit by bit.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 11 Qingyuan Health Secret, Ancient Scrolls Hidden Secrets
